integrity.originality.no_substantive_rep.reason: CARR is a domain-integrated, folded-normal expected absolute-error reduction under a signed, spatially scaled error law. The error law comes from a stacked cross-validated guide, propagated through the fixed Kriging update. The paper explicitly places this in the SUR / integrated-design lineage (MacKay, Cohn, Bect et al. 2019).
